title: Lint rules schema-unknown-column, -type-mismatch and -required-not-set
summary: Warns about fields, SQL columns and accessors that do not fit the tables of the field repository, and (off by default) INSERTs that leave out a required column
intro: Read this to see which datasets and SQL texts the rules understand, what counts as a known table, when they stay silent, and the opt-in local naming match (schema_rules.local_naming_match).
